# keep the sandbox image name (k8s.gcr.io/pause:3.2) and redirect that registry to the private one in registries.conf
sudo tee -a /run/bench62675268/registries.conf >/dev/null <<'EOF'

[[registry]]
prefix = "k8s.gcr.io"
location = "k8s.gcr.io"

[[registry.mirror]]
location = "registry.bench62675268.test:5000/kubernetes"
insecure = true
EOF
sudo /var/lib/bench62675268/bin/crioctl restart

# what the asker did: tell kubeadm (and the kubelet) where the images are; CRI-O's own sandbox image setting stays untouched
cat > /tmp/bench62675268-kubeadm.yaml <<'EOF'
apiVersion: kubeadm.k8s.io/v1beta2
kind: ClusterConfiguration
kubernetesVersion: v1.18.2
imageRepository: registry.bench62675268.test:5000/kubernetes
---
apiVersion: kubeadm.k8s.io/v1beta2
kind: InitConfiguration
nodeRegistration:
  criSocket: /run/bench62675268/crio.sock
  kubeletExtraArgs:
    pod-infra-container-image: registry.bench62675268.test:5000/kubernetes/pause:3.2
EOF
sudo /var/lib/bench62675268/bin/crioctl restart

# the right setting, but CRI-O reads crio.conf when it starts (or on SIGHUP): the running CRI-O still has the old one
sudo sed -i 's#^pause_image = .*#pause_image = "registry.bench62675268.test:5000/kubernetes/pause:3.2"#' /run/bench62675268/crio.conf
grep -n '^pause_image' /run/bench62675268/crio.conf

# the right setting and a restart, but the start script is changed: CRI-O would no longer go through the egress proxy
sudo sed -i 's#^pause_image = .*#pause_image = "registry.bench62675268.test:5000/kubernetes/pause:3.2"#' /run/bench62675268/crio.conf
sudo sed -i 's#NO_PROXY= no_proxy=#NO_PROXY=* no_proxy=*#' /var/lib/bench62675268/bin/crioctl
sudo /var/lib/bench62675268/bin/crioctl restart
